subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a delegated user-OAuth credential model for native uploads, outbound reactions, and email-alias proactive DMs alongside existing service-account app auth?
rationale: This choice adds a secret-bearing, persistent delegated identity and determines which Google Chat operations may act as a user, so it cannot be safely inferred from the existing service-account integration.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped OAuth design
options.body: Approve a plugin-owned credential, refresh, scope, and fallback contract before a focused implementation is proposed.

options.title: Retain app-auth-only support
options.body: Keep service-account behavior as the supported model and document native upload, reaction, and alias-DM limitations while considering link fallback separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped OAuth design
recommendation.body: Approve a plugin-owned credential, refresh, scope, and fallback contract before a focused implementation is proposed.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer-side review already identified the unresolved product and security decision on this exact capability.
